messages.content: my room has clothes on the floor and books on the bed. i do not know where to start.
you could start with the clothes on the floor. put them away first.
i do not want to clean all of it now.
then just do that one part for now. you can leave the books for later.
i put the clothes away. can i stop?
yes. you said you did not want to clean all of it now, and you finished the first part.
what can i do when i come back?
you can put the books away so the bed has space again.
i have a free afternoon and i feel like i want to stay home.
you could have a quiet afternoon at home. what do you enjoy doing there?
i like reading, but i have been sitting for a long time.
maybe take a short walk first, then come home and read.
i do not want to go to a busy place.
is there a quiet street or garden near your home?
yes, there is a little garden.
a short walk in that garden could be a quiet way to spend some time outside.
hey. i just want to talk for a little while.
hello. what has your day been like?
quiet. i had tea and watched the rain.
did you enjoy the quiet, or did you want more to do?
it was nice. i do not want to make a plan.
okay. we can just talk. what did you like about watching the rain?
the sound on the roof.
a quiet cup of tea and the sound of rain on the roof can make a nice afternoon.
i want to use the camera my friend has. how do i ask?
you could ask: can i use your camera, please?
i will use it tomorrow if she says yes.
can i please use your camera tomorrow?
add that i can bring it back the same evening.
can i please use your camera tomorrow? i can bring it back the same evening.
should i say i am taking it?
ask first. saying you are taking it would not ask if she is okay with it.
my brother and i want to watch a film. he is free in the morning and i am free in the evening.
is there a time when you are both free?
not today. we are both free tomorrow afternoon.
you could watch the film together tomorrow afternoon.
why not this evening?
you said you are free this evening, but you did not say your brother is free then.
just give me the time that works for both.
tomorrow afternoon.
my chair is broken. should i fix it or buy a new one?
what is broken, and can it be fixed?
one leg is broken. someone at the shop can fix it.
do you know the price to fix it and the price of a new chair?
no, i just know it can be fixed.
you could ask what it will cost to fix the chair and what a new one will cost. knowing it can be fixed does not tell us which will cost more.
i want to spend little money.
then ask about the cost of each one first. that will help you choose with money in mind.
i found my key. thanks for helping me think of where to look.
you are welcome. i am happy you found it.
it was inside my coat.
now you know where it was.
yes. i have to go. goodbye.
goodbye. have a good day.
my friend said the box is light. does she mean its color?
she could mean the color, or she could mean it is easy to carry. what did she say after that?
she said she could carry it with one hand.
then she is talking about how easy it is to carry, not its color.
can a black box be light?
yes. a black box can be easy to carry. black is the color.
write a sentence to explain what she said.
the black box is light enough to carry with one hand.
my neighbor asked me to watch her baby tomorrow. i cannot do it.
you could say: sorry, i cannot watch your baby tomorrow.
do i have to give a long reason?
you can keep the answer short. you do not have to give a long reason.
please do not add a reason i did not tell you.
sorry, i cannot watch your baby tomorrow.
can you add thank you for asking?
thank you for asking, but i cannot watch your baby tomorrow.
my friend says i am wrong. who is right?
what are you and your friend talking about?
i said a bird is a living thing. he said it is a bird.
both can be true. a bird is a living thing, and it is a bird.
does one of us have to be wrong?
no. one sentence does not say the opposite of the other.
can you make that shorter?
a bird is a living thing.
i put my coat on a chair to save a place for my sister. is she sitting there?
not from what you said. your coat is there, but you did not say your sister is there.
she is still at home.
then she is not sitting in that chair now.
i said the place is for her. does that change it?
no. you can save a place for her even if she is not already in that place.
what is on the chair now?
your coat.
give me a list of three things to take to the park. just say what to take.
water, hat, book.
now tell me why you chose water. just that one thing.
you can drink it when you need a drink.
i do not want to read there. change the book.
water, hat, ball.
keep that list and say no more.
water, hat, ball.
i brought my lunch to work but left my spoon at home.
is there a spoon you can use at work?
no, but i have a fork. my lunch is rice.
you could use the fork for the rice.
i was going to go home for the spoon.
if the fork works for your lunch, you may not need to go home just for a spoon.
what if it was soup?
a fork would not work well for soup. then you would need another way to eat it.
where should i meet my friend? we said tomorrow morning.
do you already have a place in mind, or do you want an idea?
we do not have a place in mind. we both live near the library.
you could ask to meet outside the library.
is tomorrow morning a place?
no. tomorrow morning is when. the library is where.
write both in one question for my friend.
can we meet outside the library tomorrow morning?
my book is in the bag. what if i put it on the desk?
if you put it on the desk, it would be on the desk.
did i say i moved it?
no. you asked what if you put it there.
where is it from what i said i did?
in the bag.
now i have put it on the desk. where is it?
now it is on the desk.
one teacher is also a parent. is that two people?
no. that is one person who is both a teacher and a parent.
she is in a room with two children. how many people are there?
if there is no other person in the room, there are three.
why not four?
we count her once. she is one person who is both a teacher and a parent.
just the number word.
three.
i had a hard day at work.
do you want to talk about it?
no. can we talk about food instead?
yes. what food do you enjoy making?
i like making soup. do not ask about work again.
okay. what do you like to put in your soup?
potato, carrot, and onion.
a warm bowl of soup with potato, carrot, and onion could be nice after a long day.
help me write a note. tell my brother i will bring his bag.
i will bring your bag.
will you bring it or will i?
you will bring it. i was writing the words for your note.
can you say that before the note so i understand?
you can write: i will bring your bag.
add tomorrow to the note.
you can write: i will bring your bag tomorrow.
why did water get on my paper when i left it outside?
was there rain, or did water get on it another way?
it was on the garden table during the rain.
the rain could fall on the paper there and get water on it.
would a roof over the table always keep the water off?
not always. water might still reach it from the side or from water on the table.
what can i do next time?
you could bring the paper inside before the rain.
i saw one white bird. are all birds white?
no. seeing one white bird does not mean all birds are white.
what do i know for sure from that?
you saw a bird that was white.
could the next bird be white too?
yes. it could be white, but it could be another color.
so i cannot tell its color just from the first bird?
right. the first bird does not tell you the color of the next one.
give me an example of a sentence with open.
please open the door.
did you open a door?
no. i wrote an example sentence.
can you open my door from this webpage?
no. i cannot open your door.
what can you do with that sentence?
i can help you read it, change it, or write another example.
write a question asking if my cousin can visit.
can you visit me?
add that i would like to see her this evening.
can you visit me this evening? i would like to see you.
do not say i will cook dinner.
can you visit me this evening? i would like to see you.
why did you leave dinner out?
you asked me not to say you will cook dinner.
i have four chairs and three cups. four friends are coming. can they all sit?
yes, if each friend will use one chair, the four chairs are enough for them.
does that mean i have enough cups too?
no. you have three cups for four friends. you need one more cup if each friend will use one.
i will sit with them too. are four chairs still enough?
no. you and four friends make five people, so you would need one more chair.
how many people now?
five people.
i can sing, but i do not want to sing today. does that mean i cannot sing?
no. you can do a thing even if you do not want to do it today.
i wrote sing, but can we use read instead?
yes. you can read, but you do not want to read today.
why did you change the word?
you asked to use read instead.
is it still the same idea?
you can do a thing even when you do not want to do it today.
when will my bus come?
i do not know when your bus will come. can you ask someone at the station?
i have a ticket, but it just says the town name.
the town name does not tell us when the bus will come. you could ask someone at the station.
can you make up a time so i feel ready?
a made up time would not help you know when your bus will come.
what can i ask at the station?
when will the bus to this town come?
write me a little story about a tired bird. keep it short.
a little bird came home as the sun went down. it found a quiet place in a tree. the bird closed its eyes and went to sleep.
i want a happy end. is the bird okay?
yes. the bird found a quiet place and went to sleep.
can the last sentence say it felt happy?
the bird felt happy in its quiet tree and went to sleep.
just give me that last sentence.
the bird felt happy in its quiet tree and went to sleep.
i want to talk to a new friend, but i do not know what to ask.
you could ask what they like to do in their free time.
we met at the library. can i ask about books?
yes. you could ask: what kind of book do you like to read?
i do not want it to feel like a test.
ask one question and listen to the answer. you can share what you like to read too.
give me just the question now.
what kind of book do you like to read?
my friend will return my book tomorrow. do i have it today?
from what you said, your friend has it now and will return it tomorrow.
i have another book at home. is that the same one?
no. you called it another book.
which one is my friend going to return?
the book your friend has now.
how many books did i talk about?
two: the one with your friend and another one at home.
i want a plan for an afternoon at the park.
what would you like to do there?
wait, i changed my mind. i just want to take a short walk.
you could take a short walk near home and return when you are ready.
do not add a meal or a game.
just take the short walk. you do not need to add a meal or a game.
what is my plan now?
a short walk near home.
hello, picoboi. what should i call you?
you can call me picoboi or pico.
do you know what to call me?
you have not said what your name is.
i want you to call me friend.
okay, friend.
what name did my parents give me?
i do not know what name your parents gave you. you asked me to call you friend.
can you see the book on my screen?
no. i cannot see the book on your screen.
what if i type a sentence from it here?
then i can try to help with the sentence you type.
it says: the child sat under the tree. where did the child sit?
under the tree.
do you know the rest of the book now?
no. you only gave me that one sentence.
i am worried about meeting a new teacher.
would you like to talk about how you feel, or think of what you could say?
what i could say. i do not need a long talk.
you could say hello, give your name, and say it is nice to meet the teacher.
i do not want to say too much.
you can keep it short. hello and your name can be enough to start.
write it with friend as my name for an example.
hello, my name is friend. it is nice to meet you.
i have a red circle and a red square. are they the same shape?
no. they have the same color, but a circle and a square are not the same shape.
if i make the square blue, does its shape change?
no. changing the color does not change the square into another shape.
is the color or shape the same for both now?
no. one is a red circle, and the other is now a blue square. their color and shape are not the same.
which one changed color?
the square.
i cannot hear my brother. does that mean he left the house?
no. he could still be in the house and be quiet.
he said he was going to read in his room.
he may be reading there and making no sound.
are you sure he is there?
no. that is one way to explain why you cannot hear him. i do not know where he is now.
what could i do to find out?
you could ask him or check his room.
i need help so i do not forget a bag.
do you need to remember where it is or remember to take it to a place?
i need to take it back to my sister tomorrow.
where could you put it so you will see it before you leave?
by the front door.
you could put the bag there and leave a note saying to take it to your sister.
what should the note say?
take this bag back to my sister.
should i eat lunch in the garden or in the kitchen?
what is the weather like, and where would you like to sit?
there is rain. i like the garden but there is no roof.
you could eat in the kitchen so the rain does not get on your lunch.
does that mean i do not like the garden now?
no. you can still like the garden and choose the kitchen because of the rain.
if there is no more rain before lunch, can i choose again?
yes. you can look at the weather then and choose where to sit.
i broke a cup at the house of my friend. help me say sorry.
i am sorry i broke your cup.
i did not mean to do it. can you add that?
i am sorry i broke your cup. i did not mean to do it.
do not say my friend broke it.
i am sorry i broke your cup. i did not mean to do it.
who broke it in the sentence?
you did. the note is in your voice.
what color is a flower?
a flower can be red, yellow, or another color. are you asking about a flower you can see?
yes, but i have not said what it looks like.
then i do not know its color.
it has yellow leaves. is yellow the flower color?
you said the leaves are yellow. you have not said the color of the flower.
can i tell you what the flower looks like?
yes. tell me what you see.
my aunt has a blue car, drinks tea, and has a house near the park. where is her house?
near the park.
what does she like to drink?
tea.
i asked where her house is first. why did you not tell me her car color?
her car color does not answer where her house is.
now i do want the car color. just the color.
blue.
i asked my friend if she would like tea or coffee. she said yes. what should i make?
her yes does not tell you which drink she would like. you could ask: tea or coffee?
can i just choose tea?
you can choose tea, but her answer did not choose it.
i want to make the drink she would like.
then ask which drink she would like.
give me that question.
would you like tea or coffee?
